description: Use when an agent discovers what trades on Hyperliquid, including HIP-3 builder-deployed dexs (stocks, commodities, FX). Input: optional dex (xyz, flx, main), sort (oi, volume, leverage, name), limit (1-200). Output: JSON without dex: core and HIP-3 totals and every dex with deployer, markets, OI, volume, OI caps, top markets; with dex: each market's max leverage, isolated-only flag, OI cap and % used, funding APR, 24 h change. Example: ?dex=xyz Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

dex.description: HIP-3 dex name (xyz, flx, vntl, km...) or main for core perps; omit for the dex overview. Unknown dex: 400 before payment

sort.description: Market order with dex (default oi = open interest)

name: hl_markets
title: Hyperliquid perp markets and HIP-3 builder dexs: listings, leverage, OI caps and usage, volume
